page.content:
Gold cup used since 1974 — the one Messi kissed in 2022.

How FIFA World Cup Trophy connects

  • Topic: FIFA World Cup — The FIFA World Cup Trophy is the prize of the modern tournament.
  • Character: Lionel Messi — Messi lifted the FIFA World Cup Trophy in 2022.
  • Item: Jules Rimet Trophy — The Jules Rimet Trophy was retired before the current FIFA World Cup Trophy.
  • Faction: Germany national team — Germany lifted the current trophy in 2014.

What is FIFA World Cup Trophy?

The FIFA World Cup Trophy replaced the Jules Rimet cup in 1974. Champions keep a replica; FIFA keeps the original that Germany, France, and Argentina have lifted since.
